identity: Redtusk herds and hunts the open savanna; scorpions, rats and a bandit water-broker skim the herds and the wells.

quests.title: Already Ours
quests.text: Our herders found that water together and filled the barrels themselves; Korr's bandits mean to sell it back to them. Untie the held water load at the edge of the {name:bandit_camp}, {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}, and report back to me. Leave the barrels ready for collection; enough backs have paid for that water already.

variants.text: Our herders found that water together and filled the barrels themselves; Korr's bandits mean to sell it back to them. Untie the held water load at the edge of the {name:bandit_camp}, {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}, and report back to me. Leave the barrels ready for collection; enough backs have paid for that water already.

Vek's collectors took stores and tools from households that refused his rain tithe. Untie those supplies at the edge of the {name:bandit_camp}, {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}, so they can be collected, then bring me word. The gardens need those hands at work, not empty at another man's door.

quests.lesson: A use at a place at a camp's edge, out of its leader's sight.
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3.5/§3.6 and K11 A: supplies the bandits hold at the edge of the existing camp, untied so they can go back; no water filling, no escort.

quests.title: Keep the Herds Fed
quests.text: A thirsty herd needs feed as well as water, and bellowing at me supplies neither. Bring me eight Corn for the animals. We have enough trouble with Korr's trade without letting the herds go hungry beside it.
quests.lesson: The zone's first errand, a level only; the early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Where the Water Goes
quests.text: We know how much water our herders carry; what reaches the herds is another matter. Take word of the missing loads to Kesh Longstride at Redtusk Outpost. He watches the cart tracks, and I want to know where they stop being ours.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Something Besides Dust
quests.text: My watchers come back from the heat with dust in their mouths and precious little to look forward to in the pot. Bring me five Sunleaf for their supper. They can endure a hard watch without having to taste it afterwards.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: A Pen Worth the Name
quests.text: The pens have gaps wide enough for an animal to call an invitation. Bring me eight Acacia Wood Fences to close them. I have water to carry and gates to mend, and I am tired of finding the herd halfway through my next job.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Room at the Water
quests.text: Waterhole Zebras crowd our herds away whenever the animals try to drink. Hunt eight by day in the {name:tallgrass}, which lies {zone_area:tallgrass}. Our herders work too hard for their water to watch it from a distance.
quests.lesson: A day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Shade for the Waiting
quests.text: The animals queue for water under a sun that has never waited for anything. Bring me twelve whole logs of any tree from outside the settlements for shelter posts. We will put shade over the waterholes, with room for a tired herder underneath.
quests.lesson: A craft from Basic recipes; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Rokka Knows the Load
quests.text: Rokka Emberhand knows those water loads because she helped fill them, not because she read a tally. She is being held in the {name:bandit_camp}, {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}; go and hear what she has seen. Ask her whose barrels changed hands, and she can give you more than a number.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: {name:water_broker_korr} Owes Us
quests.text: I know the barrels Bandit Water-Broker Korr sells; I helped fill them before his men took them. Kill him in the {name:bandit_camp}, {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}, and return to me. He makes our herders pay twice, once with their backs and once with the coin he demands.
quests.completion: Korr's trading is finished, and I can still name the people who bought those loads. We will put the barrels beside their rightful owners in the account; he does not get to take that knowledge with him.
quests.lesson: The named perpetrator at his place; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: Who Paid for the Water?
quests.text: I can name the loads Korr sold and the herders made to pay for water they had already carried. Take my account to Thorga Roadspeaker in Gor Drazhak. Tell her Rokka Emberhand remembers whose work filled every barrel; a new price does not make a new owner.
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: the departure id stays; free from 19, it requires nothing and claims no earlier deed (draft §1, §2).
